name: QG-I510: Available Contribution and dependent values refresh without a page reload
description:
Objective: QG-I510: Available Contribution and dependent values refresh without a page reload.
Preconditions: Open Bug regressions calculator with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Bug regressions calculator.
2. QG-I510: Available Contribution and dependent values refresh without a page reload.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The invalid or unauthorized action is rejected and no unintended state change is made.
